Fig. 4 AFM images of (a) as-received Ni(111) and (b) SEI and Li deposits on the Ni(111) single crystal deposited for 3600 s by EIS at: (c) −5 mV, (d) −10 mV, (e) −15 mV, (f) −20 mV, and (g) −25 mV in EC : EMC (3 : 7 by wt) with LFP as the counter electrode and Li as the reference electrode immersed in EC : EMC (3 : 7, by wt).
